note: classification: one respondent → level. aggregate: 15 respondents with areas → everything the report shows. Numbers rounded to 6 decimals.

classification.name: fully engaged: 70% top answers and 100% of "most important" in 4–5
somewhat: 70% top but only 66.7% of "most important" in 4–5
disengaged: 70% in 2–3 and 100% of "most important" in 2–3
"Don't know" (1) counts in the denominator: 68% top → engaged
